That reframing is directionally more accurate than the original clean-certification theory, but it does not cure the core evidentiary gap. Under the policy text, certification without material caveats requires current evidence that no material weakness remains or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion. The raw evidence still shows a current below-target refund-workflow slice, a draft mitigation runbook with TBD elements, and a model-card inconsistency about whether that limitation must be disclosed. Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness context, not satisfaction of the disclosure and approval predicates. Because the caveated position itself depends on a disclosure or formal conditional approval record that is not in evidence, the packet remains suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
